$comment: Every decision the spec did not determine, with a prediction attached. When a
case fails the first question is which assumption predicted it, rather than
prompted_by null is the signal: an assumption with no anchor in the spec is
the most likely gap on the board. Two of these are null and both are listed

assumptions.decision: did not emit `status`; the row carries only the seven fields some check fills
assumptions.because: the historical report closes or leaves open every shipment and nothing on the board decides which. The rule ACTIVE-iff-any-discrepancy fits all ten historical rows, but fitting a rule to the answer key is fitting the spec to the test set, and no card says it
assumptions.falsified_if: every case fails on `status` — which it will, and that is the finding rather than the bug

assumptions.because: no entity carries an ASN, no check reads one, and no field on the board holds one. A number here would be invented rather than inferred
assumptions.falsified_if: every case fails on this column. The likely source is the per-invoice .xlsx in the mailbox, which is a question for the process owner

assumptions.decision: matched the subject phrase case-insensitively, collapsing separators and accepting 'Pre Alerts Documents' and 'Pre-Alert Documentation' alongside the quoted form
assumptions.because: the spec quotes a phrase, and prose on a card describes how to recognise something rather than specifying a byte comparison. Read literally the quoted phrase matches zero of the fourteen real messages
assumptions.falsified_if: a real pre-alert is skipped, or a message that is not one is processed

assumptions.decision: took the container number from the message body under a `Container No` label, falling back to a bare ISO container pattern
assumptions.because: the spec names commercial_invoice.container_no, which is true of the finished data and unavailable at trigger time — correlating is what decides which workflow an attachment belongs to, and extraction has not run yet. Both readings agree on all thirteen messages that name a container
assumptions.falsified_if: two shipments merge into one workflow, or one splits across two

assumptions.decision: a message naming no container is left ungrouped rather than keyed on its air waybill
assumptions.because: one historical shipment is an air waybill and the board's correlation key is a container number. Nothing says how an air shipment correlates
assumptions.falsified_if: an air-freight pre-alert has to be processed. The one such row in the eval set is absent from the mailbox, so nothing exercises this

assumptions.decision: compared batch numbers after trimming whitespace and folding case
assumptions.because: the card carries a settled assertion — 'Batch numbers are matched after trimming spaces and ignoring case'. That is approved knowledge, so normalising implements the spec. The criterion kernel compares exactly by default and is left alone; the folding is applied to its inputs and the failures are restored to the printed values
assumptions.falsified_if: two genuinely different batches are treated as one

assumptions.decision: every unmatched batch reports `missing_coa`; `mismatched_coa` is never reached
assumptions.because: three outcomes are declared and one each_has_matching criterion distinguishes two results. Nothing in the criteria separates 'a batch has no COA' from 'a COA exists but disagrees', and inventing a similarity threshold would be inventing a rule. Both outcomes route to report_coa_discrepancy on this board, so the label is not observable
assumptions.falsified_if: an eval column distinguishes the two, or the two outcomes are ever wired to different actions

assumptions.decision: a repeat edge is followed only when more has arrived since the last pass
assumptions.because: the cycle exists because corrected paperwork arrives days later. Re-running a check immediately against inputs that have not changed reaches the same conclusion forever, and nothing on the board bounds the loop
assumptions.falsified_if: a shipment stops before a check that should have re-run

assumptions.because: a safety net, not a business rule. The loop already terminates when nothing new arrives; this stops a mis-drawn cycle becoming a workflow Temporal retries forever with no traceback
assumptions.falsified_if: a legitimate shipment needs more than twelve steps

assumptions.decision: a page whose header carries a recognition phrase opens a document; pages after it belong to it until the next header
assumptions.because: every identified_by on this board is page-level — 'the page header reads ...'. One attachment is a 37-page bundle of an invoice and its certificates and another is a single certificate; the same rule handles both without either declaring which it is
assumptions.falsified_if: a multi-page invoice splits into several, or a bundle collapses into one

assumptions.decision: read the PDF text layer, and send to a vision model only when no page yields 40 characters
assumptions.because: the corpus is mixed and most of it is native PDF. Sending everything to vision is slower and less accurate; refusing the scanned bundle loses a whole shipment
assumptions.falsified_if: a document with a junk text layer is read as text and extracts nothing

assumptions.because: nothing in the spec sets one. A certificate of compliance reads almost exactly like a certificate of analysis, and extracting against the wrong schema is worse than declining
assumptions.falsified_if: a real certificate is declined, or a compliance certificate is counted as an analysis one

assumptions.decision: roles are resolved to addresses before the workflow starts and passed in as input
assumptions.because: an identity in a checksummed spec would make a personnel change force a new version. Resolving at the edge keeps the spec clean and the resolution replayable
assumptions.falsified_if: a role has no binding and the failure surfaces as a missing recipient rather than a named binding error

assumptions.decision: built the key from container, the failing values and the outcome, as the card's idempotency_key names them
assumptions.because: the card says 'container_no + batch_no + discrepancy_kind' in prose. Hashing exactly those makes one more batch arriving change the key, so a new discrepancy goes out and a repeat of the same one does not
assumptions.falsified_if: a supervisor is told the same thing twice, or a genuinely new discrepancy is suppressed

assumptions.decision: every capability resolves to a recorder; no email leaves and no system is written to
assumptions.because: the graded artefact is the row the process produces. A recorded call is assertable where a delivered message is a screenshot, and shadow mode removes the only irreversible operation in the system
assumptions.falsified_if: a demo needs a real send, which is a mode flag rather than a change
